notice: Ours, reviewed like code (docs/design-scalable-regions.md 5.8). Coverage is the one deliberate statement of reach. This list reproduces the 1.1.0 boundary (regions/us-ca-bay-area.geojson, 32 counties) exactly: of norcal only Butte, of sacramentofoothills all but Nevada County, and eastsierra narrowed to Alpine. Widening it (for example to norcal, sacramentofoothills and an eastsierra without the shapes entry) is a decision to show and score observers in more counties. names, order and expand only change how places read and draw: a short display name, sibling order (listed first, the rest by name), and which top-level places the map shows subdivided under All.
